selection.reason: Impact scored and summarised by Gemini.

summary: The App Store Accountability Act requires large app store providers and app developers to verify user age categories, obtain verifiable parental consent before minors can download or purchase apps, and protect the confidentiality of age verification data. It establishes compliance reviews through the Federal Trade Commission, grants enforcement authority to both the FTC and state attorneys general, and preempts state laws related to these provisions.

affected_groups.effect: Must implement age verification, parental account linkage, parental consent mechanisms for minors, data security for age verification info, and real-time age/consent sharing with developers.
Must check user age categories and parental consent status via app store signals, notify app stores of significant changes, and avoid sharing age data with third parties.
Minors under 18 must have their accounts linked to a parental account and require parental consent to download apps or make purchases. Parents receive clear disclosures and consent controls.
Granted authority to issue guidance, review and certify app store compliance, receive complaints, and bring civil enforcement actions or lawsuits for violations.
affected_groups.group: Federal Trade Commission and State Attorneys General

key_provisions: Covered app store providers with more than 5,000,000 U.S. users must verify the age category of individuals creating accounts and require accounts for minors to be affiliated with a verified parental account.
App stores must obtain verifiable parental consent before allowing a minor to download, purchase, or make an in-app purchase, and must notify parents of significant changes to apps.
App stores must protect the confidentiality of age-verification data by limiting its collection and storage to what is strictly necessary and using safeguards like industry-standard encryption.

App developers must use app store signals to determine user age categories, verify parental consent before enforcing terms of service on minors, and refrain from sharing age category data with unaffiliated third parties.
The Federal Trade Commission must issue compliance guidance, establish a 1-year renewable compliance certification mechanism for app stores, and provide a public complaint mechanism.

Violations of the Act are treated as violations of rules defining unfair or deceptive acts or practices under the Federal Trade Commission Act, allowing enforcement by the FTC and state attorneys general.
App developers are granted a safe harbor from liability under the Act if they rely in good faith on age data from app stores, comply with developer obligations, and follow industry standards.
missing_information: Specific civil penalty amounts or fine structures for violations of the Act are not detailed in the text.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The App Store Accountability Act requires large app store providers and app developers to verify user age categories, obtain verifiable parental consent before minors can download or purchase apps, and protect the confidentiality of age verification data. It establishes compliance reviews through the Federal Trade Commission, grants enforcement authority to both the FTC and state attorneys general, and preempts state laws related to these provisions.
summary_detail.significance: This legislation introduces nationwide requirements for app stores and developers regarding age verification and parental consent for minors, preempts state-level regulations on the same subject, and enforces compliance through federal and state legal actions.
